record.question: Which was first virus detected on ARPANET, the forerunner of the internet in the early 1970s?
record.explanation: Creeper is the experimental early1970s ARPANET program identified by this historical description and the only matching printed name. Security-vendor histories use the name Creeper virus. Precision note: it is more accurately described as an experimental mobile/self-replicating program or early worm, not a modern file-infecting virus. The historical naming and the stricter technical classification should be kept distinct. Verified solution (unofficial); original printed source and technical explanation audited26October2026. References: https://encyclopedia.kaspersky.com/knowledge/years-1970s/; https://www.ibm.com/think/topics/malware-history
